notes.title: Update 7.8.0. New Stuff
notes.content:
[p]JANE KEYES: grace in a skirt, fire in her eyes[/p][p]Meet the NEW HEROINE — fierce yet graceful Jane.[/p][p]A seductive vixen who broke the hearts of many daring men. Her star began to rise within the walls of a rowdy saloon, where danger lurked for every girl at every table. But for Jane, it became the perfect cover.[/p][p]No lock can stop this trickster, no server can withstand her. And like any true mercenary, she always has an ace hidden up her sleeve.[/p][p]Her talents are remarkable: she can easily cause trouble for her enemies by dealing AoE damage and creating explosive portals that leave behind hazardous fire puddles. What’s more, she can lift debuffs from herself and get immunity to them while using her active abilities.[/p][p]
Unique Weapons’ NEW PERK[/p][p]Stronger, more dangerous, and battles even more thrilling![/p][p]Just as a single shot can change the course of a fight, the unique weapons’ NEW PERK can turn the tide of your battle.[/p][p]One hit — and the shockwave deals instant AoE damage. After that, all opponents caught in the blast become especially vulnerable: they won’t be able to use their active abilities, and the damage they take from your active abilities or your ally’s will increase![/p][p]A truly valuable aide in every battle![/p]

notes.title: Season 48. The Laughing Dead
notes.content: [p]A dreadful new spectacle has rolled into town. They call themselves the Laughing Dead—a twisted circus troupe that spreads sinister laughter wherever they go. What horrors lurk under the big top? None have survived to tell. If you’re not careful, your next laugh might be your last.[/p][p]Step up with your guild to experience a dangerously fun season. Survive the show and claim a show-stopping grenade launcher worth the price of admission.[/p]

notes.title: Update 7.7.0
notes.content: Server functionality improvements, bug fixes

notes.title: Steel Prairies
notes.content: [p]In a distant universe, the Wild West never died—it evolved.[/p][p]Welcome to the Steel Prairies, where dusty trails meet cutting-edge tech and saloons are run by machines. Modest living has been reforged into high-caliber survival. But as tech advanced, so did the crimes. Outlaws have forged undead laced with machinery, and now their army is loose.[/p][p]The locals are tough and their gear is sharp, but they’re outgunned. Let's tip the balance. Saddle up and join the fight to reclaim the Steel Prairies![/p]

notes.title: Season 47. Twisted Wishes
notes.content: [p]If you could have anything you wanted, could you keep your wits about you? Hopes and dreams can twist into desperation, awakening sinister genies that lurk in the shadows. They prey on reckless ambition. [/p][p]In this season of mirages, illusions run deep, and every wish carries a price. Stay sharp, fight alongside your clan, and beware the genie's temptation. Survive the season to earn masterfully crafted miniguns—a wish finally granted with no strings attached.[/p]

notes.title: Birthday time — Left to Survive turns 7 years!
notes.content: [p]Time flies when you're fighting for survival. Making it seven years is no small feat and it's time to celebrate! Join our birthday bash packed with cake, carnage, and plenty of surprises. We’re firing up the grill for a good old-fashioned barbecue, and everyone’s invited—including the ravenous zombies who’ve hunted us since day one! Just for tonight, we’ll set aside our differences and party like there’s no tomorrow. Generous gifts await...if you survive the festivities![/p]

notes.title: Season 46. Total Demolition
notes.content: [p]This season, it’s time to bring the house down! Power tools roar across the battlefield as concrete crumbles and chaos reigns. This is your invitation to step into the fray. Rally your guild, strap on your hard hats, and form the ultimate demolition crew. The more destruction you cause, the greater your rewards — because the path to victory is lined with rubble. Master the craft of controlled mayhem to unlock exclusive pistols that hit harder than a wrecking ball![/p]

notes.title: Evergreen Horde
notes.content:
An obsession with greenery has fused death with nature, mutating a group of undead into plant hybrids of flesh, flowers, and rot. To them, this is the pinnacle of evolution—why shouldn’t the world bloom with such horrific beauty?

Now, they’re recruiting new fanatics to spread their cause. While they don't want to eat you, they do want to induct you into their botanical club—permanently.

Reject their invitation and prune the plague before humanity becomes compost in their nightmarish garden.

notes.title: Season 45. Industrial Revolution
notes.content:
Gearheads, listen up! This season is all about steampunk and glorious machines.

Humanity’s ingenuity has forged a world powered by steam — brimming with intricate devices and classic Victorian fashion.

Join the industrial revolution and earn exclusive weapons, crafted by the brilliant minds of tomorrow — each one a testament to the power of progress.
As the gears of a new era begin to turn, it’s up to you to seize the future with your own two hands!

notes.title: Season 44. Deadly Corrida
notes.content:
Corrida is a very risly game. Better to say: deadly risky! But the skill of bullfighters cannot leave anyone indifferent, and their fearlessness knows no granite, because it is impossible to foresee the outcome of a fight with a bull!

Learn all the subtleties of the bullfighters' skills. This art can be useful in the battle with zombies.

Earn the title of matador! Get cool, powerful miniguns as a reward!

notes.title: Zombie golden horde
notes.content:
The Lunar New Year celebration is upon us! As the Wood Snake prepares to slither into the spotlight, another group has plans to steal the show.

Decked out in special Lunar New Year attire, the zombies are crashing our party! But where did they even get their gear? They look... surprisingly stylish.

Forget the party invite—your mission is clear: eliminate the festive zombie horde and earn exclusive Lunar New Year rewards before they ruin the celebration.

Happy Lunar New Year, everyone!

notes.title: Christmas party
notes.content:
A blizzard decorated the post-apocalyptic world for the holiday! 
The streets are garbed in snow, with weird icicles everywhere and the hoarfrost is alive.

It's our turn to get ready and decorate the Christmas tree!
The zombies are in business too, dressed all warm for winter fun, while the Siren has turned into a true snow queen.
Everyone helps to decorate the tree in time for the holiday.

And the gifts are waiting for everyone!
Join in the fun! Hurry and get the holiday gifts!

notes.title: Season 41. Steel angels.
notes.content:
In a world ruled by chaos, your defiance is your strength! Embrace the outlaw spirit as you hit the open road with the wind at your back and the promise of adventure ahead. 

Rally your clan, conquer challenges, and earn exclusive weaponry that will transform you into a true road warrior. Will you rise as a highway legend, or will the brutal path ahead claim another victim? 

The choice is yours—rev your engines and ride on into a thrilling new season!

notes.title: Season 40. La Gala de Las Calaveras. Live now.
notes.content:
Caramba! How colorful, vibrant, and festive! Marigold leaves and colorful guirlands are everywhere, the music plays, and everyone laughs.
The festively dressed Calaveras are spinning in a merry dance.
It's a true gala of the dead bursting with life!

Season 40. La Gala de Las Calaveras. Live now.

Get a Calavera makeover and give in to the mood of a vibrant fest!
Let your gala end with a pile of gifts!

notes.title: Season 39. Jupiter's Fury. Live now.
notes.content:
The people enraged Jupiter, a supreme god, and the lord of the sky.
With his mighty hand, he sent down upon them a punishment.
Humanity has to deserve the mercy of the Thunderer.

Season 39. Jupiter's Fury. Live now.

Curry favor of the mighty god and protect humanity!
The most valiant warriors will earn truly divine prizes and maybe even the blessing of Jupiter.

notes.title: Season 38. New Era Champions. Live now.
notes.content:
Their victories are undeniable.
They have no equal in sports, and their achievements are impressive.
They are the sports stars of the post-apocalyptic world — champions!
After all, every era must have its heroes.

Season 38. New Era Champions. Live now.

Show off your sports talents and set new records.
Receive the title of champion.
A reward awaits its winners — cool championship revolvers!

notes.title: Season 36. Path of the Warrior. Live now.
notes.content:
The Māori are born warriors.
They have no fear, and their bravery knows no bounds.
They bring back trophies from the battlefield: military glory and their enemy’s power and skills.
Nothing can break their spirit!

Season 36. Path of the Warrior. Live now.

Embark on your very own path, attain the warrior wisdom of the Māori tribe, and learn all their secret techniques.
Become a true warrior and prove you’re worthy to receive powerful weapons!

notes.title: Cybershaman from the future!
notes.content:
A familiar future, nemeses, and new friends.
More time travel to the future!

Madmen from the Hattori Syndicate just won’t settle down.
World domination haunts them; they dream of it.
Let’s put an end to this!

Help might arrive from where it’s least expected.
A leader of the underground tech-noir world, he always stays in the shadows.
Taiga Hemara is a shaman, a cybernetics genius, and a legend among those in the know.
His multifaceted abilities are impressive and terrifying.
Gain his support!

notes.title: Season 35. Exquisite Geometry. Live now.
notes.content:
Every line can hide the luxury within it. 
The union of steel and gold creates a fabulous contrast.
Feel the Art Deco chic!

Season 35. Exquisite Geometry. Live now.

Succumb to the charms of the most luxurious patterns! Get chic prizes!

notes.title: Season 34. Dragon Heart. Live now.
notes.content:
A symbol of power and greatness — the Imperial Dragon!
Only the worthiest will be granted his grace.

Season 34. Dragon Heart. Live now.

Conquer this mighty beast! Become worthy of his gifts!

notes.title: Season 32. The Lost Souls. Live now.
notes.content:
Their story was obliterated a long time ago, but legends still remain.
They continue to wander the world in search of deliverance.

Season 32. The Lost Souls. Live now.

Set the phantoms free and find their hidden treasures!

notes.title: Season 31. Dark Harvest. Live now.
notes.content:
What gifts can Mother Nature surprise us with in the dark times?!
It's time to reap the harvest.

Season 31. Dark Harvest. Live now.

Harvest all the prizes!

notes.title: Left to Survive’s 5th Anniversary!
notes.content:
Birthdays only come round once a year.
And milestone birthdays are even more of an occasion!

Left to Survive is 5 years old!

New guests will be joining the party—a mysterious hero and a terrifying Siren.
Plus, new missions and a PvP map await you.

Join the celebration and get gifts!

notes.title: Season 28. Deadly Pressure. Live now.
notes.content:
The apocalypse forever changed the lives of humanity! They will have to build a new world on the ruins of an old one.
Danger lurks at every corner now.

Season 28. Deadly Pressure. Live now.

Get a truly apocalyptic grenade launcher and crush zombies!

notes.title: Season 27. Knights of Today. Live now.
notes.content:
Knights' campaigns, tournaments and orders became history a long time ago.
But the glorious knighthood is still alive and stands against evil.

Season 27. Knights of Today. Live now.

Become a knight and defeat zombies!

notes.title: Season 26. Forgotten Future. Live now
notes.content:
Do you remember how the people of the past used to see the future? Let's explore that reality!

Season 26. Forgotten Future. Live now.

Dive into a world that never was! Get prizes from the future that have been left in the past.

notes.title: Season 25. Winter festivities. Live now.
notes.content:
Holidays are around the corner! But they can't happen without traditional fun.

Season 25. Winter festivities. Live now.

Join the folk fun. Enjoy festivities and get winter prizes.

notes.title: Season 24. Curse of the Druids.
notes.content:
The Druids' peace has been disturbed. No one can hide from their magic.

Season 24. Curse of the Druids. Live Now.

Break the spell of the forest wisemen. Claim a magical celtic weapon.

notes.title: Enter the steampunk world!
notes.content:
A totally different Earth, a totally different beginning to the 20th century!
Steam rules the show here and zeppelins sail the sky.

But the nascent Neue Erde Rabe has already infected this world with zombies.

Save the alternative Earth and get an outlandish weapon!
Don't let zombies enslave this realm!

notes.title: Season 22. Scarab Treasures. Live Now.
notes.content:
For centuries, they were hidden from the world.
Treasures of great pharaohs.
So desirable, yet brings danger.

Season 22. Scarab Treasures. Live Now.

Avoid the traps! Escape the scarab-guardians.
Reach the treasures of Egyptian rulers!

notes.title: It's Left to Survive's 4th Birthday!
notes.content:
This happens once a year.
Left to Survive Birthday!

Humans and zombies traditionally celebrate it together.

Land them a hand with the arrangements.
And of course, surprises are waiting for everyone.

notes.title: Season 21. Dead West. Live Now.
notes.content:
Wild West: a charm of saloons and everyday danger.
But zombies rule here now.

Season 21. Dead West. Live Now.

Are you desperate enough for a wild fight?
The reward is waiting for true Dare Devils.

notes.title: Major Update: Clan Wars!
notes.content:
It's time!
Clans will take a stand against each other! 
The battle is going to be great!

Clan Wars.

Protect your territories and conquer your enemy's.
Several wars per week await your clan.
Reach top leagues and get the most unique rewards.

That's not all!
More new stuff is waiting for you in the game.

notes.title: Season 20. Black Sails
notes.content:
A cursed ship under the pirate flag is wandering the seas.
No one wants to encounter its crew.

Season 20. Black Sails. Live NOW.

Become the Sea Wolf!
Go get trophies worthy of a true pirate.

notes.title: Season 19. Ghost of Olympus
notes.content:
Mount Olympus is a symbol of the ancient gods' might!
Reach their glory!

Season 19. Ghost of Olympus. Live Now.

Become worthy of the Olympians.
Get rare rewards!

notes.title: Friends from space? Unlikely!
notes.content:
What could be worse than zombies?
Aliens that decided an apocalypse on Earth would be the perfect time to enslave it.
Looks like we will have to disappoint them and send them back!

notes.title: The future is calling!
notes.content:
A futuristic city, breakthrough technologies. This is it, a very bright future...almost!
Madmen from the Hattori Syndicate are planning to enslave the world.

Configure the portal and save the future!
Get ready for a "warm" welcome!

notes.title: Reveal secrets of lepreсhauns!
notes.content:
Even the leprechauns are prepared to fight back against the zombies.
Maybe that's why they chose a MINIGUN! The undead won't stay in one piece after such a greeting.

Season 18. The Armed Leprechaun. Live NOW.

Don't miss a chance to get the unique leprechaun MINIGUN.

notes.title: Travel back in time!
notes.content:
The past is calling, and the adventure continues! 
Neue Erde Rabe doesn't stop trying to enslave the world. 

It's time to get all scientists together and to adjust the portal. 
Save the day! Meet a new hero.

notes.title: Dance to the rhythm of samba!
notes.content:
The post-apocalypse is not an excuse to cancel a Brazilian carnival.

Let the show begin!

Season 17. Undead Carnival. Live NOW.

Dance to the rhythm of samba.
Get festive prizes!

notes.title: Learn the secrets of vikings!
notes.content:
Vikings are fearless north seafarers.
They are famous for being fierce warriors in battle.
Do you want to learn their secrets?

Season 16. Niflheim. Live NOW.

Embrace the fighting spirit of the vikings.
Get loot worthy of a glorious warrior.

notes.title: Left To Survive is available on Steam NOW!
notes.content:
[b]The post-apocalyptic world of Left To Survive is coming to Steam![/b]

Life is no longer what it used to be. The world is teeming with the undead. No place to run or hide. Become a hero of this zombie-apocalypse reality.
- join tournaments
- collect an arsenal
- get valuable gear
- build a base – a new home for many survivors
- start expeditions to meet the heroes
- challenge other players in PvP matches and helicopter raids

Play [b]Left To Survive[/b].
Save humanity!
